reconstruction_decisions.decision: Preserve existing wells, settlements and fields; add a planted field edge. These placements are authored.
Back-project a patchy grass/scrub mosaic; a 1839 corridor account does not map 1792 patch boundaries.
Use Lahore swamp evidence as a regional habitat analogue only; this is not a located Gujranwala river reach.
Seasonal water extent is an authored comparison; no measured 1792 hydrology, river course or calendar binding.

taxonomic_corrections.decision: Do not create a willow from this pairing; historical occurrence and specimen identity remain unverified.
